'''X-C33''' was a type of substance. After [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist]] forces [[Battle of Devaron/Legends|captured]] [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Bolla Ropal/Legends|Bolla Ropal]] on [[Devaron/Legends|Devaron]], the [[Rodian/Legends|Rodian]] [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] was [[Torture/Legends|tortured]] aboard a [[Munificent-class star frigate/Legends|''Munificent''-class star frigate]], and was injected with a full dosage of X-C33 by order of a [[B1-series battle droid/Legends|B1-series battle droid]].<ref name="Cargo of Doom" />
